chapter: Brass bands, Eddie Miller and band stories
title: Eureka Brass Band, Pete Bocage and Algiers neighbours
summary: Talk of seeing Pete Bocage play with the Eureka band and where Bocage, Kid Ory and other Black musicians lived in Algiers.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: You know who I heard, uh... Well, last night I was at the Cabildo Museum and they had the Eureka brass band and they had the colored brass band.
Well, doesn't Peter still live in Al Jays?
Yeah, he lives on Valette, 1006, I think it is.
And he plays beautiful second drum.
Valette. Valette. And then, then, going out further on Verrett used to have a trombone. Ori, kiddo. Ori used to live out there, too, in Al Jays.
Harrison Barnes is another colored drummer.
Yeah, very fine. But, uh, they are since the days of, I mean, of prominence with guys like Ori and them.
